name: @blopus-ai/openclaw-plugin
description: The web search API for all your agents. Search, read full pages, and find real images — over an index Blopus crawls itself rather than reselling another engine, so nobody else's quotas or price changes sit between your agent and the web. blopus_search covers web and news in one index, with freshness windows, include/exclude domains, topic filters, and inline full text so there is no second round trip. blopus_fetch returns complete page text for up to 50 URLs in a single call, for the price of one search — batch instead of looping. blopus_images is a dedicated image index that returns pictures of the subject, not the hero image off an article. blopus_topics lists the exact filter vocabulary and is free; it costs no credits. One key works across every agent you run. Commercial use is included on every paid plan. Get an API key at blopus.ai
author: Blopus

scripts.build: tsc index.ts --outDir dist --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck
